job.job_description:
Responsibilities


- Leading AI software engineering initiatives from design through deployment, coordinating technical direction across client engagements
- Advising clients on practical uses of machine learning, generative AI, and automation within software products and platforms
- Designing scalable application architectures, APIs, and integration patterns that support evolving business needs
- Overseeing development teams through code review, testing, debugging, and release management for complex software solutions
- Applying programming languages, cloud tools, and modern development frameworks to build and enhance intelligent applications
- Translating business requirements into technical roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation approaches
- Validating model outputs, application behavior, and system performance against defined functional and technical requirements
- Guiding teams through ambiguous problems by using systems thinking, sound judgment, and clear technical communication
- Coaching team members on software engineering methods, delivery planning, and applied AI development practices
- Monitoring delivery risks, escalating blockers when needed, and driving resolution across cross-functional stakeholders


What You Must Have


- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 12 + years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required


What Sets You Apart


- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Demonstrating AI engineering experience across client-facing delivery projects
- Applying systems thinking to translate business needs into technical solutions
- Leading cross-functional teams through ambiguity, complexity, and change
- Crafting clear messages for executive and technical stakeholders
- Coaching team members while advancing inclusive team performance
